mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe (user_id, name, difficulty, cook_time, steps, nutrition, extra_ingredients, ingredients_input, preference) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{difficulty}, #{cookTime}, #{steps}, #{nutrition}, #{extraIngredients}, #{ingredientsInput}, #{preference})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR ingredients_input LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe SET is_favorite = #{isFavorite} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE recipe SET rating = #{rating} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM recipe ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
